events.event: an older copy of an hw2 file is mounted instead of this one (the owner was sent several today); the sheet's title carries an older version or has no dock

hypothesis.claim: inside the sheet nothing is held that the sheet shows: the goal is the main button in the dock, the numbers the chat gave are the file line and the foot, the written student's name is the line the sheet shows on the next open; so the held lists of the chains inside the sheet are empty or have one item, and B = 2 holds
falsified_if: the owner loses the goal, a number or the written student's name although the sheet displayed it
a step inside the sheet is narrated as needing something kept in mind that the chain does not list

scoring.coding: from what the owner says in the chat unasked, a screenshot sent unasked, and the run's record if it is ever pasted: the transcriber codes each event using the event and observable columns only, writes the outcomes file, and only then runs the script; the p column is not read while coding. Nothing is requested from the owner.

outcome.1: the observable condition is met by what the owner sent
outcome.0: the event's segment is shown (a record, a message about it) and the condition is not met
outcome.null: the segment is not shown: the event is not scored (most events, on this pass)

scoring.brier: mean over scored events of (p - o)^2, against the constant forecast at the mean p and against 0.5; also per basis and per segment
scoring.kendall: not scored: no segment has a measured duration
scoring.onsets: narrated losses within two steps of a predicted onset at B = 2 (none are predicted: every chain peaks at 2 slots), B = 3 and B = 4 as registered
scoring.p02be: the observed rate of events whose steps carry a verifier finding against events whose steps carry none; unregistered frictions; false findings
scoring.owner_leaves: nothing. The tool's own record (复制最近一次记录 in the sheet, kept on the phone) scores the events it shows if the owner or the coordinating session ever pastes it; the coordinating session reads such records by counts only

P-02be.claim: a chain can pass by omission: the silence of the verifiers does not mean a step is smooth
shown_on_this_pass_if: an unregistered friction sits at a step where no verifier fired
a finding sits at a step the owner calls smooth

load model.claim: the chains, written from the code, find where the owner is slowed
falsified_if: the events at steps with a finding occur no more often than the events at steps without one, over at least 15 scored events

the publisher's own assumptions.claim: the first real run reveals what the mock could not
shown_if: I4, I5, T4, B1 or W4 occur: the real Canvas answered something the script did not expect

H-externalized.claim: the sheet carries what the owner would otherwise hold (B = 2)
falsified_if: the owner loses the goal, a number or the written student's name although the sheet displayed it

limits: written by the author of the publisher, of the fixture and of this generator, with no second reader, and after the first build had already been sent to the owner
the weights are ordinal and uncalibrated (P-67a1); amounts are guesses; 27 of the 41 probabilities are guesses and 7 predict that nothing goes wrong
the loads are not comparable with the registration for 0.2.2: the held lists changed by a hypothesis (H-externalized), not only by the build

the sheet was measured on a mock Canvas in headless Chromium at 390x844 touch with this container's fonts, not on an iPhone, not on the real SpeedGrader, whose own controls may cover the 初稿 button; the drag was tested with real touch events and a mouse in Chromium, not in WebKit
the owner is ill, and this is a pass under that condition, which the model does not know about
most events can be scored only if the owner says something unasked: with nothing requested, many will stay unscored, which is the price of asking for nothing
if the owner ran any version before this registration was pushed, this registration is void for that run: the outcomes may be coded but are post hoc
S2 to S12 are conditional or optional chains: their events are scored only if the segment happens
